name: io.github.tonyyang0504/freelancer-deals-mcp
description: Freelancer (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting, submit_bid, withdraw_bid, bid_status, list_mes

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCER_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Freelancer OAuth access token sent as the freelancer-oauth-v1 header: a Personal Access Token from https://accounts.freelancer.com/settings/develop ('valid for thirty days') or a token from your registered OAuth app (scopes basic, fln:project_manage, fln:messaging, fln:user_information as needed).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCER_BIDDER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Freelancer user id (GET /users/0.1/self/ → result.id); required by POST /projects/0.1/bids/ as bidder_id.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCER_MILESTONE_PERCENTAGE
environmentVariables.description: Initial milestone percentage (20–100) required by POST /projects/0.1/bids/ ('Please fill in the milestone percentage (20 - 100)').
